title: send_osc
description: One OSC message to put on the wire.

address.title: Address
address.description: The OSC address, starting with a slash.

args.title: Arguments
args.description: Numbers, strings and booleans. An integer goes out as int32, any other number as float32.

to.title: To
to.description: Where to send it, as address:port. Omit to send to everything in send_to.
